name: Alcóntar (Spain)
description: White field with a yellow canton bearing a blue wavy stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcóntar (a tree, waves and a chequy field).
history: Municipal flag of Alcóntar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcóntar arms — tree, waves and chequy
